old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-5m15","title":"adaptive_sf_select does not clamp assigned_sf/return to [7,12] (latent, pre-existing)","description":"Found by security codereview of worker6-b7z9.30.3 (density threshold 8 + floors). Rust RfHealthMetrics::adaptive_sf_select (rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs ~:414) takes assigned_sf: Option\u003cu8\u003e unvalidated and returns it unclamped: adaptive_sf_select(Some(0), None, None) -\u003e (0, true); Some(200) -\u003e (200, true); Some(6) -\u003e 6. The new floors only raise under bad RF; they do not bound the returned SF. Currently latent: the only callers are tests feeding schema-valid 7-12 values. But spec 2a.8/02-physical-link define ASSIGNED_SF as a DIO-signaled 1-byte field — when a future caller wires DIO signaling into this function, attacker-influenced bytes will reach radio configuration directly. Fix: clamp sf to [7,12] (SF_MIN/SF_MAX per spec 2a.8:636) at entry or before return, or validate assigned_sf and reject out-of-range. Also mirror in the C gradient.c sf_select if it has the same shape.
